title: VertiRTA: Bare-Metal Fault-Tolerant Run-Time Assurance, Coaxial eVTOL Control, Multi-Aircraft U-Space, and Bilingual Autonomy Platform
description: Open-source Apache-2.0 deterministic flight-control, run-time assurance (RTA), and verification platform for the VertiRTA-X8-240 coaxial X8 eVTOL and 8+1 Lift+Cruise aircraft along Istanbul's Maltepe-Dragos-Kartal coastal corridor bounded by DHMI AIP LTFJ/LTBX CTRs. Integrates a freestanding zero-heap bare-metal C++17 flight core (28,886 B Cortex-M7 Flash, 0 B static RAM, 2,960 B stack DAG), STM32H753 ITCM/DTCM firmware, Renode dual-FCC OpenCyphal CAN-FD SIL (12.50 ms failover), ESBMC v8.7.0 supplemental formal proofs (1,905/1,905 properties), 102.85M-node 4D HJI-CBVF-QP safety filter, 1,000+180 C++20 Monte Carlo failure-boundary suite, zero-GPL MAVLink v2 UDP RTA shield (p50 = 18.0 us), 38.5 KiB WebAssembly VertiGCS console, nanobind Python/Gymnasium SDK, 20-eVTOL U-Space + Part-IS cybersecurity + Fleet Z3, and isolated bilingual Qwen3-4B Z3-GRPO co-pilot and zero-ShareAlike PIDNet-S visual SLZ perception.
notes: Open-source Apache-2.0 software provided as-is without warranty. References to DO-178C, DO-254, DO-330, EASA SC-VTOL, Part-IS, SORA 2.5, and SHGM SHT-IHA describe architectural alignment rather than airworthiness certification.
